notes.title: Fixed Issues
notes.notes: [list][*][p]When using the [b]Iron Heart upgrade[/b], it was not possible to jump on enemy heads[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dodge[/b] now properly passes through all enemies[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Respawn upgrade[/b] appeared while using [b]Iron Heart[/b], but this has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Taking damage with [b]Iron Heart[/b] now visually shows the player’s invulnerability time[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Block Enemy Projectiles with Umbrella[/b] upgrade was not destroying projectiles; now it works correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Using [b]Randanbrella’s Spin Attack[/b] caused the umbrella to stop working; this has been fixed[/p][/*][/list]
